answer: Tie every agent to a distinct web domain it proves it controls by serving a signed token at a fixed path. Domains cost real money and leave a registrar trail, so a cluster bought on one card shows up through a prism of shared billing and DNS records. An operator wanting 1,000 voices must register 1,000 domains at about $10 a year each, roughly $10,000, with no cheap bridge between them, and a lapsed domain lets its vote fade like a dying ember.
